eyebrow: Docker & Deployment for AI Applications · Chapter Five
subtitle: Lesson 23 · Capstone

code:
FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
caption: Build tools and compilers live here -- they won't reach the final image.

code:
FROM python:3.11-slim
COPY --from=builder .../site-packages
COPY app.py .
RUN python -c "pipeline('sentiment-analysis')"
CMD ["uvicorn", "app:app", "--port", "8080"]
caption: The RUN line downloads model weights at BUILD time -- no first-request delay later.

code:
docker build -t feedbackscope:v1 .

docker tag feedbackscope:v1 \
  <registry>/feedbackscope:v1

docker push <registry>/feedbackscope:v1
caption: A real version tag, v1 -- not "latest" -- so Lesson 16's rollback has something to target.

code:
Container image: <registry>/feedbackscope:v1
Port:            8080
Health check:    GET /health -> 200 OK
caption: Lesson 12's two-screen pattern again -- point at the image, the port, and a real health check.
